question: Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's see the meaning of the line and other words given in the options.
 
 
• At last we came to (3) ________ peaceful island, with no sign of human (4) ________ . 
 
• Here the lines is expressing that the place where the author had reached had no signs of human.
 
• one that occupies a particular place regularly, routinely, or for a period of time.
 
• Human is working as an "**adjective" **here.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **inhabitants.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Human People **will be the wrong combination according to the meaning of the sentence.
